This product includes annotation data (English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese) from Unicode CLDR 48.2
(release-48-2), including tables generated from that data.

This product also includes Unicode Emoji 17.0 sequence data and generated tables.

Emoji sequence data: Copyright © 2025 Unicode, Inc.
Annotation data: Copyright © 1991-2025 Unicode, Inc.
CLDR distribution: Copyright © 2004-2026 Unicode, Inc.
SPDX-License-Identifier: Unicode-3.0

The accompanying LICENSE.txt is the unmodified license from that release.
Include this notice and LICENSE.txt with redistributed data or associated
documentation, including distributions embedding the generated Go tables.
